result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of restaurant imagery. A few minor truncation issues also appear at screen edges.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a generic broken-image placeholder icon on a gray background instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source or loading logic; provide a branded fallback image or skeleton loader so a raw broken-image icon is never shown to users.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated name ('Trattoria Piccol...') that is clipped by the screen edge without an ellipsis, making it look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card width, or ensure the horizontal carousel clearly indicates more content is scrollable.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge, appearing as an empty partial pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/padding or add a fade/gradient edge to signal horizontal scrolling so partially visible chips still look intentional.
